newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia Jan-Oct copper production up 1.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia Jan-Oct copper production up 1.7 percent.

text.p: Mongolia's output of copper concentrate was 292,100 tonnes in January-October, up from 287,300 tonnes produced in the year-ago period, official statistics showed on Friday.
Production in October alone was 29,600 tonnes, up from 27,600 in October 1995, the State Statistics Bulletin said.
Exports of copper concentrate in the period were 411,800 tonnes, up from 359,000 tonnes in the same period last year, the report said but gave no further details.
